(b)
has not complied with the relevant code of conduct

(c)
has  failed  to  exercise,  discharge  and  perform  the
powers,  functions  and  duties  of  such  office  for  a
consecutive  period  of  more  than  three  months

(d)
is  disqualified  in  terms  of  the  provisions  of
subsection (2) of section 18.
(3) Any person appointed under subsection (2) of section
16 may be removed from office, with the concurrence of the
Minister,  upon  a  decision  of  the  Governing  Board,  in  the
event the Governing Board is satisfied following a hearing
of the relevant person that such person–

(a)
is  unable  to  exercise,  discharge  and  perform  the
powers, functions and duties of such office because
of an infirmity of body or mind that has lasted for
more than a period of three months;

(b)
has not complied with the relevant code of conduct
of the Central Bank; or

(c)
has  failed  to  exercise,  discharge  and  perform  the
powers,  functions  and  duties  of  such  office  for  a
consecutive period of more than a period of three
months without approval of the Governing Board.
